solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique after crossings); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Songbird principally nesting under material on roof

indicators.note: principally means chiefly, so only the leading letter of each of nesting and under is used

parts.note: thatch is straw or reed laid as roofing

explanation.surface: A bird nests mostly in the straw of a cottage roof.
explanation.walkthrough: 'under' looks like a position indicator placing the bird beneath the roof, but it is just a second word whose leading letter is taken.
explanation.definitionFit: The nuthatch is a small woodland bird that climbs trees head-first, a type of songbird.

clue.text: Accepted in Jodhpur, serving ship's officer

indicators.note: letters accepted into the run of words Jodhpur serving sit concealed inside them

explanation.surface: Someone in Jodhpur, the Indian city, is taken on as a waiter.
explanation.definitionFit: A purser is the officer in charge of accounts and passengers' welfare aboard a vessel.

clue.text: Painstaking, albeit lacking in refinement

parts.note: albeit means though, shortened in informal writing to tho'
rough means coarse, unpolished

explanation.surface: Careful work that is nonetheless crude in its finish.
explanation.definitionFit: A thorough worker is careful and attends to every detail, which is what painstaking describes.

clue.text: American journalist subjected to exploitation

parts.note: ED, short for editor, is the crossword journalist

explanation.surface: A reporter from the States is taken advantage of.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone exploited has been made use of by others, an adjective sense of the past participle.

clue.text: After struggle, woman raised capital in Europe

parts.note: to vie is to compete or struggle

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means the name is written upwards, reading backwards

parts.note: Ann is a woman's name

explanation.surface: After a fight, a woman lifted up a European city.
explanation.definitionFit: Vienna is the capital city of Austria.

clue.text: Instance of arsenic being brought into church

indicators.note: being brought into says the arsenic symbol is placed within the church letters

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
As is the chemical symbol for arsenic

explanation.surface: A poisoning example: arsenic carried into a church.
explanation.definitionFit: A case is an example or occurrence of something, as in a case of fraud.

clue.text: Game played by good university teacher

indicators.note: played by means the game is placed beside the other pieces, after them

parts.note: RU is rugby union, a game

explanation.surface: A sport played by a fine college lecturer.
explanation.walkthrough: RU (rugby union, a football code) follows G and U.
explanation.definitionFit: A guru is a spiritual teacher in Hinduism, and by extension any revered mentor or expert.

clue.text: Pal I shot mistakenly — and where he ended up?

indicators.note: done mistakenly, the letters of Pal I shot are put in the wrong order

explanation.surface: A shooter confesses hitting a friend by accident and asks where the victim went.
explanation.definitionFit: A shot friend would be taken for treatment to the medical ward, where the injured end up.

clue.text: One in pursuit of spirit to follow beer, perhaps

definitions.meaning: second meaning: a short drink taken after a beer, or the beer after a spirit

explanation.definitionFit: A pursuer chases; a shot of whisky drunk after a pint is also called by the same name.

clue.text: Creature identified by duke on small low-lying island

parts.note: a key (or cay) is a low island or reef, as in the Florida Keys

explanation.surface: A nobleman spots an animal on a tiny islet.
explanation.definitionFit: A donkey is an animal, a domesticated member of the horse family.

clue.text: Almost set out to be a celebrity

indicators.note: almost means the word falls short by its final letter

parts.note: to start is to set out on a journey

explanation.surface: Someone nearly sets off on the road to fame.
explanation.definitionFit: A star is a famous performer, a well-known personality.

clue.text: No longer virginal, but not pursued, we hear

indicators.note: we hear says the word for not pursued is taken by its sound

parts.note: un- is the prefix meaning not; chased means pursued

explanation.surface: Someone lost their innocence without ever being courted.
explanation.definitionFit: Unchaste means not pure sexually, having lost one's virginity.

clue.text: Size of area in top conurbation

indicators.note: in places the area letter inside, between top and conurbation

parts.note: a cap is a top or lid
a city is a large urban area

explanation.surface: How large a district is within a leading metropolis.
explanation.definitionFit: Capacity is the volume something can hold, its dimensions or extent.

clue.text: Farmer digesting extremes of horror in crime novel

indicators.note: digesting means taking something inside, so the farmer surrounds the letters

parts.note: a tiller is one who tills the land

indicators.note: extremes of horror means its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A farmer devours the gory bits of a murder mystery.
explanation.definitionFit: A thriller is an exciting story, typically of crime or espionage, full of suspense.

clue.text: "Two portions of meat — and be quick about it!"

parts.note: Two says the cut of meat appears twice, so a second chop joins the first
a chop is a portion of meat, such as a lamb or pork cutlet

explanation.surface: A diner orders two cutlets and urges the waiter to hurry.
explanation.definitionFit: Chop-chop is an informal exclamation urging someone to hurry up, from pidgin English.

clue.text: Pair entertaining great fondness for shore bird

indicators.note: entertaining means holding as a guest, so the pair letters surround the fondness

parts.note: love is great fondness

explanation.surface: A couple fond of a seaside bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A plover is a wading bird of beaches and mudflats.

clue.text: Change item in variety show

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to alter or become something different
second meaning: an act or performance on a bill

explanation.definitionFit: To turn is to alter in form, and a music-hall act is also called by the same word.

clue.text: Army poet's sleeveless jacket

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's reserve force
a bard is a poet

explanation.surface: A soldier-poet wears a sleeveless garment.
explanation.definitionFit: A tabard is a short sleeveless tunic, once worn by heralds and knights over armour.

clue.text: Take a lot of time to become socially accepted?

parts.note: take, as in 'it will take ages', means be when speaking of duration
long means for a lengthy time, as in 'it won't take long'

explanation.surface: It can take ages for a newcomer to fit in.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as two words the answer means 'take ages'; the question mark flags that split.
explanation.definitionFit: To belong is to fit in with a group and be accepted as a member.

clue.text: Equable English archdeacon

parts.note: Ven, short for Venerable, is the title of an archdeacon in the Church of England

explanation.surface: A calm-tempered English churchman.
explanation.definitionFit: An even temper is calm and steady, which is what equable describes.

clue.text: Silver-haired poet mentioned in speech

indicators.note: mentioned in speech says the poet's name is taken by how it is said

parts.note: Thomas Gray wrote the Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard

explanation.surface: An elderly poet referred to in an address.
explanation.definitionFit: Grey hair is silver-coloured with age, so the adjective fits a silver-haired person.

clue.text: Blue pigment provided by fellow Lithuanian, perhaps

parts.note: co- as in co-worker means fellow or joint
a Balt is a native of a Baltic state such as Lithuania

explanation.surface: A colleague from Lithuania supplies blue paint.
explanation.definitionFit: Cobalt blue is a deep blue colouring made from cobalt compounds.

clue.text: Forceful surgeon engaging macho types

indicators.note: engaging means holding within, so the surgeon surrounds the macho types

parts.note: a vet is an animal surgeon
he-men are macho men

explanation.surface: A strong-willed surgeon hires some tough guys.
explanation.definitionFit: Vehement means passionate and intense, expressed with great force.

clue.text: Genuine-sounding angler's device

indicators.note: sounding says the word for genuine is taken by how it is said

parts.note: real means genuine

explanation.surface: A fishing tool that seems authentic.
explanation.definitionFit: A reel is the winding spool on a fishing rod that holds the line.
